Contact Security

1. Prohibited Actions

Visitors and automated bots interacting with aimadulislam.dpdns.org must NOT engage in any of the following activities:

  • Aggressive web scraping or crawling that exceeds 60 requests per minute.
  • Automated vulnerability scanning with tools such as Acunetix, Nikto, or Nessus without pre-approval.
  • Submitting malicious code payloads, cross-site scripting strings, or SQL payloads into public contact forms.
  • Impersonating site administrators or security personnel.

2. Automated Enforcement

IP addresses exceeding rate thresholds or triggering WAF rules will automatically be rate-limited or blocked by Cloudflare edge filters.
